query: I'm doing a big wardrobe refresh and need a few things. First, I'm looking for a popular item from Columbia that has a total sales volume of more than 1900 and fewer than 5 one-star reviews; since I'm in a bit of a rush, the transport time must be less than 3 days. For the colder weather, I need a yellow winter item from Levi's, and to ensure its quality, it must have more than 50 four-star reviews and fewer than 5 one-star reviews. While I'm at it, I'll also get an all-seasons product from Levi's that has 'Heritage Court' in its name, but I need this one very quickly so the transport time has to be less than 2 days. Lastly, I need something from New Balance for women that has a stock quantity greater than 100, over 140 five-star reviews, and less than 10 two-star reviews. My budget is between 2248 and 2254.
